# Blog Brief - the plan before the post

Curated by Skill Harbor: one sub-skill of the MIT claude-blog suite (AgriciDaniel). You give it a topic; it returns a detailed content brief: what the post should cover, for whom, in what order, with which target keywords and internal-link opportunities. It writes the plan, not the article. The gated full-write pipeline (blog-write, its 5-gate contract, renderer and screenshot checks) is deliberately NOT included. Corrected install (phase 4): installing blog-brief/ alone BREAKS the skill, because its SKILL.md (290 lines at the pinned commit) resolves 7 sibling paths under skills/blog/. The install therefore bundles the read-only skills/blog/references/ (22 files) and skills/blog/templates/ (12 files) alongside skills/blog-brief/ (SKILL.md only), preserving the relative layout, and nothing else from skills/blog/: no blog orchestrator SKILL.md, no agents, no scripts, no 5-gate contract. No account, API key or paid service is named in the SKILL.md for this brief skill itself; live web search and fetch are needed for keyword research, competitor analysis, and statistics, and if live web access is unavailable those steps must be marked unavailable or snippet-only, never invented. Search volume is not measured unless the user names a tool and a date, never estimated. Statistics in a brief are snippet-sourced candidates to verify in full before publishing, not publish-ready facts. No chart is generated, because the built-in blog-chart sibling skill is not installed. Suite-level...
